In the first three worlds the infected walk at you and the whole problem is not getting surrounded. In the fourth, some of them start firing from a distance, and suddenly what sits between you and them matters too. That is where the game changes gear.

A meteor shower brought spores from another world. Anyone who breathed the dust stopped being a person: the horde was born. You are one of the few immune, and the only way to end this is to reach the source of the infection, one world at a time.

Apocalipsis Survivor is an action survivor. You move, and the aiming and shooting happen on their own while you dodge waves that keep getting denser. You level up, pick weapons and upgrades on the spot, and build combinations that become unstoppable, or you die trying.

WHAT YOU GET

· 10 worlds and 30 stages, each with its own biome and music, from the ruined city to the alien dimension.

· 16 weapons with evolutions: pistol, shotgun, whip, orbs, laser, missiles, molotov, turrets, mines, drones and more.

· 10 playable characters, each with different stats and a different starting weapon.

· 10 bosses with telegraphed attacks you have to learn to read.

· 5 game modes: Survival, Endless Horde, Waves, Boss Rush and Rescue.

· Permanent progression: coins, unlocks, an upgrade workshop, 25 achievements and stars per stage.

· A story that unfolds between worlds, told with cinematic art.

· 12 languages: English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Polish, Turkish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

HUNDREDS OF ENEMIES, NO SLOWDOWN

The screen fills with infected and the game holds its frame rate. Play with keyboard or controller, and let the aiming run itself: you decide where to move and which upgrade to take.

TRY IT FIRST

The demo is free and includes the first 4 complete worlds and their 12 stages. It goes exactly as far as the point where the infected start shooting back.

Easy to pick up, hard to put down. How far will you get before they reach you?

Display Requirements


A minimum display resolution of 1920×1080 (Full HD) is required. At lower resolutions, interface elements may not display correctly and gameplay may be difficult. Steam Deck handheld mode using the built-in display is not supported. Keyboard and mouse required.

Civilization has fallen. Headquarters still has another day to survive.


ApocalypseHQ is a single-player, turn-based management strategy game set after a zombie outbreak. Each turn represents one day. Keep food and water flowing today while investing in the power, personnel, research, and territory your headquarters will need tomorrow.

Plan Each Day


Advancing the day resolves facility output, survivor consumption, wages, facility upkeep, supply fuel, research, and ongoing external operations. Decide whether to trade for an immediate shortage, invest in storage and infrastructure, or risk sending squads beyond the perimeter.

Your stockpile extends beyond food, water, fuel, firepower, electricity, and Z-Coin. Manage scrap metal, mechanical parts, fertilizer, weapons, and production materials while deciding what deserves space in a limited warehouse.

Secure Territory and Bring It Back Online


Build farms, water purification facilities, power plants, hospitals, free markets, research labs, and training facilities in secured empty territories. Construction is only the beginning: search each area, clear its infected population, then assign workers and qualified specialists before it can operate.

Transport networks move supplies, power networks determine which facilities can run efficiently, and communications support headquarters operations. Allocate limited generation and supply fuel, and send engineers to repair damaged facilities.

Assign and Develop Your People


Train survivors as workers or soldiers. Commanders lead squads, researchers contribute according to their degrees and specialties, and engineers operate and repair critical facilities.

Wounded troops need hospital capacity and supplies before they can return to duty. Squad members and commanders can be killed, and operations begin to unravel when headquarters can no longer cover its active-duty costs.

Send Squads Beyond the Perimeter


External operations include both supply raids and missions that secure new empty territory. Form squads around named commanders, compare friendly and enemy combat strength, and decide how many squads the objective is worth.

Load between one and three days of firepower before departure. Order a retreat when supplies run low or casualties become unacceptable. The result determines casualties, recovered supplies, and whether new territory joins your headquarters.

Commit to One Research Project


Your research lab can pursue only one project at a time. Researcher degrees and specialties, along with facility conditions, determine what can be studied and how quickly progress is made.

Unlock facilities and production recipes, or improve the efficiency of facilities you already operate. Once a facility is unlocked, you may build it in any available empty territory without a per-type cap. If an urgent need changes your priorities, cancel the current project at the cost of all accumulated progress.

Respond to a Changing Situation


Main and side quests provide longer-term direction, while daily staff briefings identify immediate problems. Choice events—including survivor arrivals, facility failures, zombie hordes, wounded rescues, and irregular trade—change actual resources, personnel, and facility conditions.

You cannot solve every problem at once. Decide what to protect, what to postpone, and what headquarters must sacrifice to survive another day.

After countless millennia drifting in space, you awaken. You will act as an agent in an operating system of a space probe from a long lost, far away civilization. Discover and invent new functionality, add to yourself and evolve to become a cosmic god.

Gain sentience over time and evolve your gameplay by discovering new apps, new ways of playing, and new secrets hidden deep within the machine code. Apotheosis Engine is an incremental game played inside an alien operating system.

Discover new gameplay in the form of new apps; the system grows as you play, unlocking new features and gameplay as you progress towards the end.

  • Solid incremental gameplay; a mix of long term goals and short term gains and lots of things to explore and secrets to find

  • An 8-12 hour experience, depending on how deep you want to go

  • Addictive idle mechanics with some new twists on the idle genre

  • Evolving and refreshing gameplay over various stages; each with completely different ways to play

  • Sleuth through the operating system and outside of the game itself to unlock hidden features, secrets, surprises, lore and easter eggs (and some more surprises on top of these)

Set in 1995 deep within a subterranean research complex, Apparatus Inspector puts you in the hot seat of an isolated observation booth. Your task: inspect incoming synthetic units and render final judgment. Evaluate dialogue, cross-reference telemetry, and verify system signatures to determine whether to APPROVE a unit—or EXTERMINATE it.

Interrogate & Evaluate Synthetic Units

Analyze dialogue for behavioral tells, cross-reference telemetry data, and render final judgment on incoming synthetic units.

Investigate Retro OS & Network Databases

Search corporate intranet registries, execute AE-DOS terminal scans, and manage diagnostics across multiple desktop windows.

Manage Physical Facility Survival

Manage power levels while tracking rogue AI on the security cameras.

Key Features

Build and automate your factory, optimize your production, and work together with friends to grow your aquatic business.

Features

60 adorable fish species, 117 appearances

Aquarium Days includes guppies, danios, corydoras, bettas, discus, arowanas, koi, freshwater stingrays, and more. Some species come in different colors and patterns, for a total of 117 appearances.

Different species move in their own ways: some swim in schools, some stay near the surface, and others spend most of their time near the bottom. New fish are automatically recorded in the catalog, making it easy to see which species and appearances you still need to collect.

18 aquarium scenes

Choose from 18 aquarium scenes featuring aquatic plants, driftwood, caves, stone steps, underwater ruins, and other layouts.

Select a scene to change the entire look of an aquarium.

Upgrade equipment and unlock more aquariums

Upgrade equipment to increase aquarium capacity, earn coins for longer while offline, and unlock more aquariums. Each aquarium can have its own scene and selection of fish.

Keep your aquarium on the desktop

You can keep the game in a small aquarium window on your desktop, or set it as an animated wallpaper.

Relax and watch, with no daily upkeep

Aquarium Days focuses on collecting and watching fish, without complicated aquarium chores. There is no water quality to manage, and your fish will not get sick or die. There are no daily tasks you have to complete.

You also earn coins while offline. Feed your fish when you feel like it, and they will be fine even if you do not open the game for a few days.

A MOTEL, AN ARCADE AND A LONG NIGHT AHEAD

Create your character, take over a roadside motel with a neon arcade next door and turn it into the stop everyone remembers. Rent out rooms, fill the hall with cabinets, feed the players, hire a crew and grow your business night after night, alone or with friends.

RUN THE MOTEL


Greet guests at the front desk, haggle over the price of a night and hand over the key. Clean up after they check out, watch your reviews and star rating, and upgrade your rooms from bare Economy to Standard and Deluxe. As the motel grows, open the Roadside Wing, fix the broken stairs and bring the whole upper floor back to life, room by room.

13 ARCADE GAMES YOU CAN ACTUALLY PLAY


Every machine in your hall is a real game you can step up to and play:

  • Video cabinets: the retro 3D racer Turbo Rush, the motorcycle racer Moto Rush, the snake battle Snake, the endless runner Neon Dash, the delivery chaos of Pizza Rush, the light-gun shooter Motel Guardian and the dance machine Step Fever
  • Sports and tables: Hoop Shot basketball, Air Hockey, 8-ball Billiards and the Haymaker boxing machine
  • Head-to-head duels: the two-player whack-a-mole Mole Duel and the two-lane ball roller Roll Rivals. Nobody plays these alone: sit down and a customer takes you on, or call a friend over in co-op

And when the hall gets too small, open your own Bowling Alley: take the bowlers' money at the shoe counter, send them to a free lane, add new lanes as you grow and roll a few frames yourself.

Customers drop in to play too. Collect the tokens, complete each game's challenges to boost your income and keep the hall running: machines break down, and an OUT OF ORDER screen doesn't make anyone money.

COOK AND SERVE

Gamers get hungry. Grill the patties, melt the cheese, drop the fries, plate everything up and serve it at the tables, then pick up the cash they leave behind. Set up diner tables and a window bar, and put a drink vending machine in the corner for thirsty customers.

HIRE YOUR CREW

You can't be everywhere at once. Hire a cleaner, a receptionist, a cook and a technician from each day's candidates, train them up and pay their wages. Your staff show up in the morning, take their posts and keep things moving while you handle the rest.

YOUR RETRO TABLET


Run the business from a handheld with a nostalgic early-2000s desktop look: check your rooms, open and close the arcade, manage your staff, track your daily goals and earnings and keep an eye on the bills. Order new machines, tables and wall decor like neon signs and framed posters from an old-school online shop. They arrive boxed, ready to set up wherever you like.

FROM LEVEL 1 TO 20

Every level unlocks something new: machines and decor, new staff, three hall expansions, new motel wings and finally your very own bowling alley.

THE DAY ENDS, THE BOOKS CLOSE

When the sun goes down, the neon lights come on and the parking lot fills up with guests' cars. At midnight you close the day and see where you stand: the cash that came in, the rooms you rented, the arcade's earnings, wages, bills and your star rating. Good reviews grow your reputation, and your reputation brings more customers to your door the next day. And on rainy days, everyone heads straight for the arcade.

PLAY TOGETHER


Invite up to three friends through Steam and talk with built-in voice chat, push to talk or open mic. One works the front desk, another runs the kitchen, and when the night gets quiet you can settle the score over air hockey, a game of pool or a round of Mole Duel.

Stroll in first person across 3 islands at your own relaxed pace, alone or with friends: a classic fairground park, a Dino Park and a Pirate Island. There you'll discover 15 minigames with online highscores and 5 rides.

Whenever you feel like it, jump into one of the minigames, where short arcade rounds full of action and fun are waiting for you.

Arcade Park Islands currently has 3 online multiplayer games:

Treasure Hunter (co-op, up to 4 players): Float together in a balloon gondola through a rocky canyon, hunt for treasure and defend yourselves against the pirates’ robot harpooners.
Duck Hunt (versus): Compete against each other to shoot the most ducks.
Air Hockey (1 vs 1): Challenge a friend at the air hockey table.

Here you shoot ducks in Duck Hunt, throw Balloon Darts, test your skills at the Air Wheel Gun or hammer away at the High Striker.If you're in the mood for a ride, switch to Night Mode, hop on one of the rides, enjoy the music and earn tickets along the way.

Things get even wilder here: feed raptors with steaks and pizza by crossbow in Dino Feed Rage, hunt with nets in the bumper cars of Dino Catch Drive, or shoot down pterosaurs straight from the moving dino roller coaster in Dino Hunt Coaster.In Dino Egg Hunt, you collect eggs with a small car and flee from the raptors, and in Dino Shock Egg, you keep the dinos at bay while you raid their nests.

Set course for adventure: fire at enemy pirate ships in Cannon Frenzy or rescue sailors from little krakens trying to pull them into the sea in Kraken Blaster.In Bots & Bottles, you prove your knife-throwing skills against drunken robots, and in Walk the Plank, you hit the barrels to the rhythm and make the robot dance.

🏠 Lodge & Collecting

Grab teddy bears at the Claw Machine, fill your teddy bear shelf, collect dino cards in the parks and complete your dino card shelf – both reward you with bonus tickets.

The lodge also has a small arcade hall with Air Hockey and a few retro minigames.

🤖 Meet funny robot NPCs in the parks.

🛠️ Development Note

I'm actively developing Arcade Park Islands and improving it with updates based on your feedback. All games are intentionally designed for short arcade rounds (1–5 min.). If that sounds like your thing, welcome to the park!

LOGISTICS IS WAR.

It is the 1980s, and the arcade boom is underway.

Build a small game studio into an arcade empire. Create hit titles, expand across the city, secure valuable businesses and outmaneuver rival companies competing for the same opportunities.

YOUR COMPANY IS ON THE MAP

In Arcade Warlord, strategy starts with movement.

Your people have to travel. Your cabinets have to be delivered. Your profits have to be collected. Every new venue adds opportunity, but also distance, travel time and pressure on your fleet.

Growth is not just about expanding faster. It is about expanding smarter.

Spread across the city to claim more territory and strategic resources, or invest capital to expand vertically and concentrate more cabinets in fewer venues. A wider network increases reach. A denser one reduces travel and lets your company respond faster.

AGENTS ARE YOUR CAPABILITIES

Your workforce is made up of specialized Agents, each giving your company different capabilities.

Sales Reps secure new venues. Haulers move cabinets and resources. Technicians repair machines and install upgrades. Bagmen collect profits. Enforcers protect key interests or pressure competitors.

The challenge is not simply hiring more people. It is building the right organization for the situation.

Too few Technicians and breakdowns pile up. Too few Haulers and production outruns logistics. Too few Bagmen and money stays trapped in the field. Every role competes for your attention and capacity.

CONTROL THE CITY

The city is more than territory to paint.

Different venues and businesses provide different advantages: income, Street Influence, Components, Business Intelligence, infrastructure and strategic leverage. Some locations strengthen your economy. Others can reshape your entire plan.

Decide where your Sales Reps should focus. Expand outward for resources and map control, or pay to upgrade nearby venues and run a tighter, more efficient network. Secure important businesses before your rivals do—and decide which opportunities are worth the logistical burden.

WHEN BUSINESS TURNS TO WAR

Rival companies are pursuing the same city, the same venues and the same advantages.

When two companies want the same location, economic competition can become territorial conflict.

Station Guards at important venues. Patrol districts. Remove rival cabinets. Raid enemy operations. Protect your own network while disrupting theirs.

Or avoid the fight altogether and win through stronger logistics, better positioning and smarter growth.

REVENUE IS PHYSICAL

In Arcade Warlord, profit is not abstract.

A cabinet earning money across town is worthless until someone collects the quarters and brings them back. Revenue flows through your operations, and operational mistakes quickly become financial problems.

Track burn rate, payroll, investment and cash flow. Decide when to cut costs, when to expand, when to liquidate, and when to commit capital to long-term growth. Your ledger is not separate from the map—it is the consequence of everything happening on it.

BUILD. DEPLOY. ADAPT.

Develop hit games, build Development Departments, hire Lead Designers, acquire IP, research better cabinets and expand your Headquarters.

Every system is connected.

A profitable expansion may stretch your fleet. More cabinets may overwhelm your Technicians. Upgrades may pull those same Technicians away from repairs. A great location may become a liability if you cannot support it.

There is no single correct path to victory. Grow through better games, stronger logistics, territorial control, financial power—or a combination of them.

Build the company. Deploy the company. Control the city.

Command the Arcana

Arcana Rift: Tactics is a turn-based strategy game that transforms the suits and figures of Tarot into pieces on a tactical battlefield. Build your force, manoeuvre across the grid and break through your opponent's defences to destroy their Tower.

Four Suits. Four Battlefield Roles.

Every piece has a defined battlefield role, making positioning, movement and choosing the right target just as important as raw strength.

Swords are close-range fighters.
Wands attack from range.
Cups heal and support nearby allies.
Pentacles protect nearby pieces.

More powerful Court pieces expand these roles, giving you stronger and more mobile units to build your strategy around.

Build Your Army During the Battle

Your army is not fixed when the battle begins. Earn and manage resources as you fight, recruit reinforcements and decide where your resources will have the greatest impact.

Craft equipment to improve your forces and adapt your strategy as the battlefield changes.

Summon the Major Arcana

Bring powerful Major Arcana onto the battlefield, each with unique effects capable of changing the course of a battle.

Using them requires investment, forcing you to choose between strengthening your existing army, recruiting new pieces or saving resources for a more powerful summon.

Win Through Positioning, Not Luck

Movement, attack range, formations and support positioning all matter.

Protect valuable units. Isolate vulnerable enemies. Use each suit's strengths together and look for opportunities to break through the opposing formation.

Battle Offline or Online

Play against the computer in offline battles or challenge another player in online PvP. With a many possible formations, purchases, summons and tactical decisions, each battle is about fine-tuning your strategy and forging a path to victory.

Weapons are meant to be thrown.

Arcane Abyss is a pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where you fight by throwing weapons.

Swords, axes, spears—throw them straight from your hand of cards to attack monsters.

Transfer abilities through weapon synthesis, then combine them with Skill Cards to find your own way to fight.

Make weapons collide to trigger Resonance and get even more out of the abilities you've added.

Delve into the Abyss in search of rare weapons!

Resonance: throw a weapon into a weapon

Thrown weapons remain on the board. Hit one with another weapon to trigger Resonance, drawing out both weapons' abilities. Strike groups of monsters with wide-area attacks and special attacks.

When a Resonance attack catches other weapons in its path, it triggers further Resonance. Even simply scattering weapons around the board can lead to an unexpectedly powerful attack.

Keep an eye on weapon abilities that activate repeatedly through Resonance, too. As Resonance triggers again and again, synergies make those abilities more and more powerful.

It's the perfect chance to test the weapons you've enhanced through synthesis alongside your skills. Take advantage of terrain altered by elemental effects and aim to wipe out every monster.

Synthesis: move abilities to your favorite weapon

There's more to a new weapon than simply using it as it is. Use it as synthesis material to transfer its abilities to another weapon.

For example, add an ability that draws a card when you deal damage to a weapon you use often. Now you can replenish your hand with your next weapon while attacking enemies.

Will you choose raw attack power, or an ability that fits your current build? Even a weapon you'd normally overlook might hold the missing piece of the combination you've been looking for.

Skill Cards: passive perks that work on their own

Skill Cards grant passive abilities that take effect automatically once acquired. There's no need to activate them manually in battle.

MP Efficiency makes weapons with high MP costs easier to use. HP Drain restores HP based on the damage you deal. Sword Mastery enables sword attacks to land critical hits—and that's just the beginning.

Do you want more attacks, a reliable source of healing, or one devastating blow?

Combine weapon abilities and skills to shape your fighting style. With synthesis and Skill Cards, the possibilities for growing stronger are endless.

Every run, a new build

Choose four abilities through runes before setting out, and your adventure begins.

Choose your route through a branching map and work toward defeating the boss. Alongside weapons dropped by monsters, the armory lets you pick one weapon from three options. Put your build together through synthesis and skills.

Pursue the combination you had in mind, or change course to suit the weapons you find—the choice is yours. An ability you ignored last time might become the centerpiece of your build this time around.

Story: the day her home became a dungeon

One day, apprentice mage Elly comes home to find that her house has turned into a dungeon. She knows only one combat spell: channeling magic into a weapon and throwing it. Her fight against the monsters leads her down into the Abyss. The story unfolds in illustrated, picture-book-style scenes, and the Black Cat Shop awaits you at the hub.

Gameplay Videos and Livestreaming

Let's Plays, video uploads, and livestreams of Arcane Abyss are welcome. Monetization is also permitted, and you do not need to contact us in advance.

Build Your Arcane Circuit

ARCANE CIRCUIT is a dark fantasy deck-building roguelite where Emitters automatically unleash powerful spells.

Chain Your Cards. Unleash Devastating Combos.

One card is simple. But an entire circuit? The possibilities are endless.

Combine Core Cards with Modules like Burn, Frost, Shock, Mark, Split, Pierce, and Chain to create powerful spells. Adapt your build to overcome different challenges.

Fire Serpent + Ricochet = Effortless Crowd Clearing

But against a powerful boss, this setup struggles to deal enough single-target damage.

Switch to Frost Spells to Slow the Boss Down!

Reducing the boss's attack speed can significantly limit its damage output.

Unlock a Second Emitter: Fire + Frost!

With two Emitters working together, take down the boss and its minions with ease!

Explore. Collect. Evolve Your Build.

Battle through 5 distinct regions, each filled with unique enemies and challenges.

Defeat enemies to earn new cards, resources, and powerful Relics.

Build your ultimate spell-slinging machine gun!

The story so far:

Ilenor the Brave has a problem. His magic wand, his cauldron and his precious diamond have all been stolen, and the cunning witch Thazelius has run off with his beloved cat, Shadowtongue, deep into Glimmelion. Help Ilenor blast through 36 levels of retro chaos, defeat the bosses and get everything back, one magic bolt at a time!

Gameplay:

Run, jump, and shoot your way through hand-crafted pixel levels in the tradition of early-90s shareware platformers like Commander Keen, Duke Nukem and Hocus Pocus. Every enemy, projectile, and pickup is rendered in crisp, low-resolution pixel art with synthesized 8-bit-style sound effects.

Features:

  • Retro pixel graphics in the style of classic 90s shareware platformers

  • Back to basics: 36 levels to explore in every direction, spread over 4 episodes

  • Harness the power of Shadowtongue: uncover the hidden golden paw, then call on your rescued cat to wipe out up to 5 enemies on screen, twice per level.

  • Smooth parallax scrolling backgrounds unique to each episode

  • Dynamic random weather effects - lots of possible combinations!

  • Unique old school sound effects and MIDI music reminiscent of 80s and 90s games

  • CRT, handheld, terminal and sepia screen filters for that authentic retro experience!

  • Game saving and loading (up to 5 slots), including auto save

  • Ascension mode: finish the main game, then play it all again with 10 Ascension levels of difficulty modifiers that keep stacking up. Built for hardcore players!

  • Leaderboards so you can compete with friends!

ArcaneSurvivors is a horde-survival roguelite where you write your own spells by joining a verb rune to a noun rune.

Loose x Flame gives you a flame bolt; Orbit x Bone gives you a ring of bone. All 84 pairs of 7 verbs and 12 nouns have their own name and their own behavior, and 11 modifier runes take that to 1,008 combinations.

A run takes 20 minutes. Deep in an endless library where books have grown minds and the catalogue has turned feral, the further you let your sanity go, the stronger the runes you draw. How far will you gamble?

  • 1,008 combinations — 7 verbs x 12 nouns x 11 modifiers. All 84 pairs have their own name and behavior, and modifiers change how they act
  • Awakening — carry a Lv5 spell into a chest and it turns gold, changing how it behaves outright
  • Gamble your sanity — forbidden runes and altar bargains let you set your own risk and reward mid-run
  • 20-minute runs — 3 boss fights, 19 enemy types. Win, then chase your record in Endless or descend into Depths I-III
  • 5 seekers — different opening spells and different mechanics. The Censor wards enemies off; the Binder starts with two spells
  • Fill the shelves — an 84-pair spell dictionary, a 19-entry bestiary, 20 achievements, and Depths I-III to push your record
  • Japanese / English, full gamepad support

  • Numerous skills and familiars with unique behaviors

Archronica is a turn-based card battler fought across a 2×3 grid of tiles.
Each unit you summon leaves a Blessing on its tile. Hold Blessings of one element on three tiles to trigger Resonance — your units on those tiles gain +1/+1 for as long as you keep it. Your deck's two elements together on four tiles resonate too.
Where you place each unit matters: Guards wall off a column, Flyers soar over the front line, Piercing attacks punch through it. Every placement is a decision.

Five elements, five ways to fight

  • 🔥 Fire — the aggressor: Haste and burn to win before your opponent sets up
  • 💧 Water — the tactician: freeze, reflect and wash units away to control the flow
  • 🌳 Forest — the grower: hold the line with Guard and grow stronger as you fight
  • ✨ Light — the wide front: Unity and Protection for the Holy Kingdom's host
  • 🌑 Dark — the schemer: strike from Stealth, feed the graveyard, pay in sacrifice
Decks are 30 cards, up to two elements. Some cards belong to two elements at once. Your pairing defines your game plan.

Awaken your Legends

Every Legend carries an Awakening condition tied to its deck's win plan. Cast enough spells, land enough blows, mourn enough allies — fulfill the condition, and your Legend reveals its true form.

The tale of the Awakened

In a world shaped by five divine siblings, an ancient Demon Lord is stirring once more. Alen, a young villager from the frontier, touches a nameless shard — and awakens.
Story Mode includes the Prologue through Chapter 2. From Chapter 3 on, new chapters are planned as free updates after launch, one at a time.

Collect your cards

Earn cards from story and character battles, and open card packs with in-game gold. Card packs are never sold for real money — every card is earned by playing.
Some cards come in special styles, such as Foil and Full Art.

Friend matches

Play your friends online with a room code or a Steam invite.

Features

  • Placement strategy on a 2×3 grid, with Blessings and Resonance to build up your board
  • 130+ cards across five elements, including dual-element cards
  • Awakening mechanics on every Legend
  • Story Mode: Prologue through Chapter 2, with more chapters planned as free updates
  • Battles against the characters you meet in the story
  • Online matches with friends
  • Earn cards by playing — no paid card packs
  • Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese text (Japanese voices)
An internet connection is required to play (you sign in automatically with your Steam account).

WELCOME TO THE ARENA


Arena Blast is a colorful third-person arena shooter built around fast matches, different game modes, and a carefully measured amount of uncontrolled chaos.

Pick your weapon, customize your look, gather your friends, and jump into the same arena with players across Steam, Android, and iOS.

You can make a team strategy before the match. You might even follow it for the first eight seconds.

🔫 PICK YOUR WEAPON — LET YOUR OPPONENT WORRY ABOUT THE REST


Every weapon offers a different way to fight.

Push your opponents at close range, control the arena from a distance, or bring enough firepower to ruin everybody’s carefully prepared plans.

Unlock new weapons, equip your favorites, and build a playstyle that works for you. Using the right weapon at the right time gives you a serious advantage. Using the wrong weapon with unreasonable confidence can still look impressive.

BRING YOUR OWN STYLE


Defeating your opponents may be important, but you do not have to do it while dressed like everyone else.

Customize your character with different outfits and cosmetic items. Unlock new appearances, create your favorite combination, and eliminate your opponents while looking unnecessarily stylish.

You may lose the match. Looking bad is still optional.

🎮 DIFFERENT MODES, SAME CHAOS


Arena Blast features a variety of game modes with different rules and objectives:

  • Team Deathmatch: Work with your team and score more eliminations than your opponents. Teamwork is recommended. Actual teamwork is not guaranteed.
  • Free for All: No teams, no friendships, and definitely no excuses. The player with the highest score wins.
  • Capture the Flag: Steal the enemy flag, carry it back to your base, and try not to drop it halfway there. It sounds simple. It usually is not.
  • Hot Zone: Capture the objective and hold your ground. Running away is, surprisingly, not a particularly effective strategy here.
  • Zombie Invasion: Fight against waves of zombies. There are many of them, they never get tired, and none of them understand personal space.

Every mode requires a different approach. Coordinate with your team, use the arena to your advantage, or trust your reflexes and pretend the outcome was part of the plan.

THE CROWD IS WATCHING — TRY NOT TO EMBARRASS YOURSELF


Forget ordinary battlefields. In Arena Blast, you fight inside colorful stadiums under bright lights and in front of energetic spectators.

Use jump platforms, capture strong positions, and attack your opponents from unexpected angles while the crowd reacts to the action.

Make a great play and they will cheer. Make a terrible one and at least somebody was entertained.

GATHER YOUR FRIENDS


Add your friends, create a party, and enter matches together. Choose your weapons, prepare an extremely serious strategy, and then watch everyone run in a different direction during the first fight.

No friends online? Available player slots can be filled by bots. Bots will not judge you. At least not yet.

🌍 THE SAME ARENA ON PC AND MOBILE


Arena Blast supports cross-platform multiplayer across Steam, Android, and iOS.

No matter which device your friends use, you can meet in the same matches, create a party, and compete against players from around the world.

Phone or PC? The arena does not really care. An opponent is still an opponent.

🏆 COLLECT TROPHIES AND CLIMB


Win matches, collect trophies, and climb the leaderboards.

Compete across daily, weekly, and all-time rankings. Build winning streaks, improve your performance, and fight your way toward the top.

There is plenty of room near the bottom too. We just do not advertise it.

CLAIM YOUR REWARDS


Complete daily and weekly missions, earn rewards, and unlock new content.

The Battle Pass, Trophy Road, daily rewards, chests, and limited-time events provide new goals every time you return to the arena.

Because eliminating opponents is not enough. Sometimes you also need to open a chest and stare at what comes out.

FACE YOUR MATCH STATS


Review your eliminations, deaths, headshots, accuracy, and other performance statistics after each match.

If you get eliminated, the Kill Cam can show you exactly what happened. Learn from it, return stronger, and repeat the same mistake with much better technique.
